def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]
    items = items[items['ts'] < seed_time]

    merged = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
                'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                'order_estimated_delivery_date', 'order_status']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    # Доставка известна только если доставка произошла до seed_time
    delivered_mask = merged['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)

    merged['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    merged['is_delayed'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] > merged['order_estimated_delivery_date']).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )
    merged['delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(float)
    merged['approval_hours'] = np.where(
        merged['order_approved_at'].notna() & (merged['order_approved_at'] < seed_time),
        (merged['order_approved_at'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0,
        np.nan
    )
    merged['total_value'] = merged['price'] + merged['freight_value']

    base = merged[['product_id', 'order_id', 'price', 'freight_value', 'total_value',
                   'delivery_days', 'is_delayed', 'delivered', 'approval_hours',
                   'order_purchase_timestamp']]

    # Отзывы: берём только те, что уже созданы до seed_time
    reviews_known = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    rev_merge = base[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(reviews_known, on='order_id', how='inner')
    rev_merge = rev_merge.dropna(subset=['review_score'])

    # Платежи: только известные до seed_time
    pay_known = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'payment_value', 'payment_installments']]
    pay_merge = base[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(
        pay_known.groupby('order_id', as_index=False).agg(
            payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'max')),
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )

    now = seed_time

    def product_agg(df, suffix):
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name='product_id'))
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'total_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'total_items_{suffix}': g['order_id'].count(),
            f'total_sales_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'avg_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].mean(),
            f'avg_total_value_{suffix}': g['total_value'].mean(),
            f'avg_delivery_days_{suffix}': g['delivery_days'].mean(),
            f'delayed_rate_{suffix}': g['is_delayed'].mean(),
            f'delivered_rate_{suffix}': g['delivered'].mean(),
            f'avg_approval_hours_{suffix}': g['approval_hours'].mean(),
            f'last_purchase_days_{suffix}': g['order_purchase_timestamp'].max().rsub(now).dt.days,
            f'first_purchase_days_{suffix}': g['order_purchase_timestamp'].min().rsub(now).dt.days,
        })
        return out

    all_time = product_agg(base, 'all')

    hist = base[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    win90 = product_agg(hist, '90d')

    hist30 = base[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
    win30 = product_agg(hist30, '30d')

    agg = all_time.join(win90, how='outer').join(win30, how='outer')

    if not rev_merge.empty:
        rg = rev_merge.groupby('product_id')['review_score']
        agg['avg_review_score'] = rg.mean()
        agg['count_reviews'] = rg.count()
        agg['neg_review_rate'] = rg.apply(lambda x: (x <= 2).mean())
        agg['low_review_rate'] = rg.apply(lambda x: (x <= 1).mean())
        recent_rev = rev_merge[rev_merge['order_id'].isin(
            base.loc[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=90), 'order_id'])]
        if not recent_rev.empty:
            agg['avg_review_score_90d'] = recent_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].mean()
    else:
        agg['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        agg['count_reviews'] = np.nan
        agg['neg_review_rate'] = np.nan
        agg['low_review_rate'] = np.nan
        agg['avg_review_score_90d'] = np.nan

    if not pay_merge.empty:
        pg = pay_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_payment=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            max_installments=('payment_installments', 'max'),
            pay_count=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(pg, how='left')
    else:
        agg['avg_payment'] = np.nan
        agg['max_installments'] = np.nan
        agg['pay_count'] = np.nan

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
    features = features.join(agg, how='left')

    # Флаг активности товара
    features['is_active'] = features['total_orders_all'].notna().astype(float)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    # Мгновенные признаки
    features['recency_ratio'] = np.where(
        features['total_orders_all'] > 0,
        features['total_orders_90d'] / features['total_orders_all'],
        0.0
    )
    features['neg_review_rate'] = features['neg_review_rate'].clip(0, 1)

    return features.reindex(entity_ids)
